itineraries.title: WAT & PEACE: 2-DAY CAMBODIA ITINERARY
editorial: We spent two nights in Siem Reap, the gateway to Angkor Wat and the other temples in the area. If your flight timings permit, arrive a day before the temple tour and spend the evening around town.
What if we had more time?
With more time, we’d visit Phnom Penh to see more of everyday Cambodian life beyond tourist-focused Siem Reap, and to learn more about the genocide.
We went to Amazon Angkor for an Apsara dance performance and buffet dinner, reaching the fancy banquet through some decidedly less fancy back alleys.
Pub Street is an option afterwards, but get an early night: our sunrise temple tour started at 5:00 AM.
We booked our tour through Klook and had a wonderful guide, Chanthy. The route covered Angkor Wat, Bayon, Ta Prohm and Banteay Kdei. Book your tour ahead, especially in peak season.
Sunrise over Angkor Wat made the trip worthwhile on its own; we explored the temples through the morning before the heat built up.
We returned to Angkor Wat independently in the afternoon. It was blazing hot, but we almost had the view to ourselves and got some of our favourite pictures.
